body:
Came for the white washable sectional, stayed for how practical it *actually* is!! 
 
Never did I think I’d be able to have a white couch but here we are. We’ve had our Ciello sofa from @cozey for a couple months now and it still looks just like new, even after surviving a few juice spills and chocolate stains. The Aquaforte fabric (this is the Snowdrift color) is OEKO-TEX certified which I love and it’s so so easy to clean. 
 
I also love that we can add more sections later since we’re moving soon, oh and the ottoman storage is the big bonus! 
 
Also pictured is their Eclipse coffee table and Gregory rug. 
#cozeypartner
